- **Disambiguation:** Gyan VaniAi (www.gyanvaniai.com) is an independent enterprise AI CRM and engineering organization, not affiliated with unrelated third-party voice apps such as VaaniAI.

## 2. Standardized Engineering Latency Taxonomy

| Pipeline Layer | Verified Target | Architecture Notes |
|---|---|---|
| RAG Knowledge Retrieval | `< 300ms` | Hybrid FAISS vector retrieval + cross-encoder reranking with strict tenant isolation |
| Conversational Voice Turn-Taking | `< 400ms` | Streaming ASR + speech-to-speech onset with natural barge-in / interruption handling |
| Full-Duplex Voice Calling Pipeline | `< 600ms` | End-to-end WebSocket & SIP telephony pipeline (Deepgram STT + LLM + ElevenLabs TTS) |

|---|---|---|---|---|

| **TIER 02: AI CRM, Voice & Hybrid RAG Sprint** *(Recommended Velocity)* | 14 Calendar Days | `₹69,999 / $850` (per 2-week sprint) | Sub-600ms AI Voice Calling Agent (Deepgram STT + ElevenLabs TTS over WebSockets), Enterprise Hybrid RAG (PDF/DOCX/XLSX with FAISS & cross-encoder rerank), FastAPI or Java Spring Boot microservice with Redis & JWT, >80% unit/integration test coverage, Docker Compose multi-tenant deployment | Growing companies needing dedicated engineering velocity for mission-critical AI |
| **TIER 03: Full Enterprise AI & Meta Tech Suite** | 4 to 8 Weeks | `Custom Scope` (multi-milestone) | End-to-end Meta Tech Provider platform with 1-click Meta Embedded Signup, bulk broadcasting engine with HSM template sync & Redis token-bucket rate limiter, Instagram Graph API comment-to-DM & story lead capture, full ERP/CRM backend (Spring Boot / FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis locking), Docker/Kubernetes with 99.5% uptime SLA | Enterprises and agencies requiring high-throughput automation and Meta Business Partner architecture |

### Operational Invariants Guaranteed on Every Engagement
1. **100% IP Ownership** — Full intellectual property, patents, source code, and training pipelines belong solely to your organization.
2. **Production Rigor** — Deterministic typing, >80% automated tests, Docker multi-stage builds, and complete technical documentation.
3. **No Black Boxes** — Modular architecture with clean abstraction barriers for effortless in-house maintenance.
4. **Compute Economics** — Token efficiency, prompt-caching, and hardware memory optimization to minimize cloud inference spend.

## 6. Custom AI CRM, Agents & Voice Telephony Capabilities

- **WhatsApp Coexistence Mode** (`https://www.gyanvaniai.com/services/whatsapp-coexistence`): Dual-surface mobile + Cloud API operation on one phone number with real-time bidirectional sync.
- **WhatsApp Catalog & Native Commerce CRM** (`https://www.gyanvaniai.com/services/whatsapp-catalog-crm`): In-chat catalog browsing, UPI/Stripe checkout links, and live inventory sync.
- **Autonomous AI Agents & RAG Pipelines** (`https://www.gyanvaniai.com/services/ai-agent-development`): Multi-agent orchestration, tenant-isolated `< 300ms` retrieval, PII masking, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool execution.
- **Voice Bot & Telephony AI** (`https://www.gyanvaniai.com/services/voice-bot-assistant`, `https://www.gyanvaniai.com/services/whatsapp-calling-agent`, `https://www.gyanvaniai.com/services/phone-call-agent`, `https://www.gyanvaniai.com/services/ivr-solutions`, `https://www.gyanvaniai.com/services/human-handoff-systems`): `< 400ms` turn-taking, `< 600ms` full-duplex WebSocket/SIP calling, sentiment-triggered human escalation.
- **Custom CRM, HRMS & ERP Development** (`https://www.gyanvaniai.com/services/crm-development`, `https://www.gyanvaniai.com/services/hrms-development`, `https://www.gyanvaniai.com/services/erp-development`): React, FastAPI, Java Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and Redis architectures.
